slides.texte_overlay:
15 lessons in 15 years to make
oneself happier

1. Sleep fixes more than you think.

2. Morning light, every day.

3. See friends in person.

4. Fewer friends, deeper ones.

5. Cook more. Order less.

6. Eat slowly.

7. Walk without headphones.

8. Notice small things.

9. Stay a beginner at something.

10. Learn every day.
slides.texte_sophia:
9. Stay a beginner at something.

10. I learn daily
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
11. Mute what makes you envious.

12. Reply to old friends.

13. Visit your parents more.

14. Ask them about their youth.

15. Gratitude is a skill.
Practice it.
